scope: Reviewed 2026 official recreational boat rules only within the Crescent City–Del Norte draft footprint. In-season closures, MPA geometry, method, harbor and route clearance remain separate checks.

rules-gear.note: Reviewed 2026 CDFW general finfish gear: rockfish and lingcod aboard impose one-line/two-hook limits; salmon has separate Northern boat gear restrictions.

rules-invertebrates.note: Reviewed current CDFW section 29.80 recreational trap, hoop, snare, marking and tending rules; a scheduled crab season does not authorize traps without current declarations.

rules-whales.note: Reviewed whale-safe fishery status and declaration process; Northern November 2026 recreational crab trap clearance cannot be presumed in September.

rules-health.note: Reviewed CDFW health notice index; shellfish and Dungeness health closures must be checked again on the actual trip date.

rules-ocean.note: Reviewed CDFW ocean regulation index as a source directory; it does not grant position-specific fishing permission.

rules-groundfish.note: Reviewed CDFW 2026 groundfish summary and linked Northern table; Northern boat season Apr–Dec all depths and species limits differ from Mendocino.

rules-inseason.note: Reviewed dated CDFW in-season changes through September 2026, including Klamath salmon closure; later notices must be rechecked.

rules-salmon.note: Reviewed CDFW 2026 salmon page: Klamath Management Zone has no remaining 2026 opener; Smith River mouth closure and one-rod/barbless Northern boat rules apply.

rules-crab.note: Reviewed CDFW crab landing page and links to gear, health and whale-safe notices; it does not itself confirm a future recreational trap opening.

rules-book.note: Reviewed original 2026 CDFW ocean booklet for California halibut, albacore, Dungeness and on-board gear/fillet requirements; regional notices remain controlling.

rules-proposals.note: Reviewed 2026 Fish and Game Commission proposal index; proposed changes without an effective date were not treated as operative Northern rules.

rules-tuna-federal.note: Reviewed current eCFR 50 CFR 660.721: 25 albacore north of Point Conception, with trip/day possession constraints and southern-EEZ exception.

rules-salmon-pdf.note: Reviewed original August 19 2026 CDFW salmon flyer: Klamath summer guideline reached, no fall opening north of 38°02 N, and Smith/Klamath mouth closures.

rules-groundfish-pdf.note: Reviewed original January 1 2026 Northern table: Apr 1–Dec 31 at all depths, RCG ten with one copper/two canary/four vermilion-sunset, lingcod two at 22 inches, descending device.

rules-northern.note: Reviewed Northern regional page updated August 31: 42°–40°10 N, Klamath salmon closed, Dungeness closed with scheduled Nov 7 opening, Pacific halibut open subject to quota.

mpa-pyramid.note: Reviewed CDFW Pyramid Point SMCA page: only surf smelt dip/throw-net recreational exception; app excludes all MPA geometry from fishing targets.

mpa-st-george.note: Reviewed CDFW Point St George Reef Offshore SMCA page: salmon troll and Dungeness trap exceptions, plus tribal exemptions; app excludes all MPA geometry.

mpa-reading.note: Reviewed CDFW Reading Rock SMR/SMCA page: SMR no take; SMCA has salmon, surf smelt and Dungeness exceptions; app excludes all MPA geometry.

rules-pacific-halibut.note: Reviewed CDFW Pacific halibut page: north of Point Arena Apr 1–Nov 15 or earlier quota closure, one fish no minimum length, one line with two hooks when angling.
